channel.title: Aviation, shipping & logistics · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Aviation, shipping & logistics in Indian markets. Today: strong headwind (−3.1).

item.title: [−2] Brent climbs over 2% to about $102.50 as Iran steps up attacks on Hormuz tankers
item.description:
A dozen attacks hit between 28 September and 2 October; Tuesday's Hormuz flows were the lowest since late July. US Gulf producers are shutting in output ahead of a possible hurricane. Escalating, despite faster IEA stock releases.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — Jet fuel stays expensive

Why it matters: Crude above $100 widens India's import bill, keeps fuel inflation and rupee pressure high, and squeezes airlines, paint and fuel retailers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Iran's Guard says Hormuz is closed; US Central Command calls it false and says 20 million barrels are moving
item.description:
An adviser to Iran's Revolutionary Guard commander said the strait is closed and other routes would soon be shut; a tanker was attacked off Qatar. Iran also cited a safe-route understanding with Oman. Escalating rhetoric.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — War-risk insurance stays high

Why it matters: Closure threats on the route that carries much of India's crude and LNG keep insurance, freight and price risk premiums high even while cargoes still move.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] India presses Russia and Ukraine to halt attacks on ships after more Indian crew are hurt in the Black Sea
item.description:
India condemned strikes on commercial vessels and is discussing safe passage with both sides; its truce plan covers energy sites, Black Sea shipping and grain exports. Drone strikes near Bulgaria sank a ship. Ongoing.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — War-risk premiums

Why it matters: Black Sea attacks raise risk for Russian crude, fertiliser and edible-oil supply to India; a truce would ease those costs.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
